messages.content: What's the average temperature for Los Angeles in December?

function.name: calculate_bmi

weight.description: The weight of the person in kilograms. This is a float type value.

height.description: The height of the person in meters. This is a float type value.

unit.description: Unit for calculation, either metric or imperial. Default is metric

message.content:
In December, Los Angeles enjoys mild, comfortable weather. Typical averages are:

| Metric | Approximate Value |
|--------|-------------------|
| **Average high** | ~19 °C (≈66 °F) |
| **Average low** | ~11 °C (≈52 °F) |
| **Mean daily temperature** | ~15 °C (≈59 °F) |

So you can expect daytime temperatures in the mid‑60s °F (around 18–20 °C) and nighttime lows in the low 50s °F (about 10–12 °C). The city rarely sees temperatures below freezing or above 70 °F (21 °C) in December.

Los Angeles December average high ~19°C (66°F), low ~11°C (52°F). Average daily temperature maybe around 15°C (59°F). Provide typical range. No function needed.
